title: Boxing
subtitle: 「拳擊／拳擊運動」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「拳擊／拳擊運動」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: boxing 最正式、最傳統的近義詞之一。
words.example: He became interested in pugilism at a young age.
words.exampleZh: 他年輕時便開始對拳擊產生興趣。

exercises.original: He became interested in boxing while studying sports history.
exercises.zh: 他在研究體育史時開始對拳擊產生興趣。
exercises.upgrade: He became interested in pugilism while studying sports history.

options.explanation: 正式、歷史語境中是 boxing 的直接近義詞。
通常是非正式打架，不是運動名稱。

exercises.original: The museum exhibition traces the history of boxing in Britain.
exercises.zh: 博物館展覽追溯英國拳擊的歷史。
exercises.upgrade: The museum exhibition traces the history of pugilism in Britain.

options.explanation: 現代綜合格鬥，概念不同。

exercises.original: Early boxing rules gradually transformed the sport.
exercises.zh: 早期拳擊規則逐漸改變了這項運動。
exercises.upgrade: Early rules gradually transformed pugilism.

options.explanation: sparring 是訓練形式，不是整項運動。
太廣，可包括非運動打架。

words.note: 指為獎金進行的拳擊比賽，尤其是職業拳擊。
words.example: Prizefighting became increasingly popular in the nineteenth century.
words.exampleZh: 職業拳擊在十九世紀日益流行。

exercises.original: Professional boxing became a major spectator sport.
exercises.zh: 職業拳擊成為重要觀賞運動。
exercises.upgrade: Prizefighting became a major spectator sport.

options.explanation: 特別指以獎金和職業競賽為核心的拳擊。

exercises.original: He made a living from professional boxing.
exercises.zh: 他靠職業拳擊謀生。
exercises.upgrade: He made a living from prizefighting.

options.explanation: made a living 明確指職業拳擊。
通常不以職業獎金為核心。
不是合法職業拳賽的同義詞。

exercises.original: The article examines the business side of professional boxing.
exercises.zh: 文章探討職業拳擊的商業層面。
exercises.upgrade: The article examines the business side of prizefighting.

options.explanation: 商業、獎金、職業層面最吻合。

words.meaning: 「甜蜜的科學」；拳擊的傳統別稱
words.note: 拳擊界很著名的慣用表達，強調拳擊不只是力量，也包含技巧、節奏、判斷與策略。
words.example: Fans often call boxing “the sweet science.”
words.exampleZh: 拳迷常把拳擊稱為「甜蜜的科學」。

exercises.original: Fans often describe boxing as a sport of timing, strategy, and skill.
exercises.zh: 拳迷常把拳擊形容為講求時機、策略和技巧的運動。
exercises.upgrade: Fans often describe boxing as the sweet science.

options.explanation: 拳擊的傳統別稱，正強調技巧與策略。
只是「蠻力」，反而忽略技術。
一般拳頭打架，不是拳擊別稱。

exercises.original: Commentators sometimes call boxing “the sweet science.”
exercises.zh: 評論員有時把拳擊稱為「甜蜜的科學」。
exercises.upgrade: Commentators sometimes call boxing the sweet science.

options.explanation: 這是 boxing 的固定傳統別稱。

exercises.original: His book argues that boxing is as much about intelligence as power.
exercises.zh: 他的書主張拳擊和力量相比，同樣講求智慧。
exercises.upgrade: His book presents boxing as the sweet science.

options.explanation: 此別稱正好突出拳擊的技術與戰術面。
多種格鬥技術的綜合運動。

words.note: 口語／體育媒體常用，尤其指拳擊作為競技、職業和產業。
words.example: He has spent more than twenty years in the fight game.
words.exampleZh: 他已在拳壇打滾超過二十年。

exercises.original: He has worked in boxing for more than twenty years as a trainer.
exercises.zh: 他以教練身份在拳壇工作超過二十年。
exercises.upgrade: He has worked in the fight game for more than twenty years as a trainer.

options.explanation: 體育媒體中可指拳壇／格鬥行業；此處上下文已明確是 boxing。

exercises.original: She knows the business side of boxing extremely well.
exercises.zh: 她非常熟悉拳壇的商業層面。
exercises.upgrade: She knows the business side of the fight game extremely well.

options.explanation: 特別適合談教練、推廣、職業生涯和商業圈。

exercises.original: Many former champions remain involved in boxing after retirement.
exercises.zh: 很多前拳王退役後仍然活躍於拳壇。
exercises.upgrade: Many former champions remain involved in the fight game after retirement.

options.explanation: 在 boxing context 中自然指拳壇／拳擊行業。

words.note: 比 the fight game 更明確地只指 boxing。
words.example: She has worked in the boxing game as both a coach and promoter.
words.exampleZh: 她曾以教練和推廣人的身份在拳擊界工作。

exercises.original: She has spent her entire career in boxing.
exercises.zh: 她整個職業生涯都在拳擊界。
exercises.upgrade: She has spent her entire career in the boxing game.

exercises.original: Promoters play an important role in professional boxing.
exercises.zh: 推廣人在職業拳擊界扮演重要角色。
exercises.upgrade: Promoters play an important role in the boxing game.

options.explanation: 推廣人、拳手、教練等整個產業語境很自然。

exercises.original: He entered boxing as a teenager and later became a coach.
exercises.zh: 他青少年時進入拳壇，後來成為教練。
exercises.upgrade: He entered the boxing game as a teenager and later became a coach.

options.explanation: 自然表示進入拳擊運動／產業。

words.note: 描述性地強調 boxing 是在拳擊擂台進行的運動。
words.example: The ring sport demands excellent timing and footwork.
words.exampleZh: 這項擂台運動要求出色的時機掌握和步法。

exercises.original: Boxing requires excellent timing and footwork.
exercises.zh: 拳擊這項擂台運動需要出色的時機掌握和步法。
exercises.upgrade: The ring sport requires excellent timing and footwork.

options.explanation: 在上下文已知是 boxing 時，可作描述性改寫。

exercises.original: He has trained in boxing since childhood.
exercises.zh: 他自小便訓練這項擂台運動。
exercises.upgrade: He has trained in the ring sport since childhood.

exercises.original: The documentary examines how boxing changed over the twentieth century.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片探討這項擂台運動在二十世紀如何演變。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary examines how the ring sport changed over the twentieth century.

options.explanation: 有明確 boxing 上下文時可作自然概括。
不是 boxing 的正式歷史名稱。

words.meaning: 以拳頭進行的競技格鬥；拳擊運動
words.note: 描述性說法，強調 boxing 是「規則化、運動化的拳頭格鬥」。
words.example: Boxing developed from earlier forms of fist fighting as a sport.
words.exampleZh: 拳擊由較早期的拳頭競技形式演變而來。

exercises.original: Boxing developed from earlier forms of regulated fist fighting.
exercises.zh: 拳擊由較早期規則化的拳頭競技形式演變而來。
exercises.upgrade: Boxing developed from earlier forms of fist fighting as a sport.

options.explanation: 描述性地保留「拳頭＋競技規則」的核心。

exercises.original: Boxing is a regulated sport based mainly on punching.
exercises.zh: 拳擊是一項主要以拳擊為核心的規則化競技運動。
exercises.upgrade: Boxing can be described as fist fighting as a sport.

exercises.original: For a beginner, boxing can be explained as organized fist fighting with rules.
exercises.zh: 對初學者來說，拳擊可解釋為有規則的拳頭競技。
exercises.upgrade: For a beginner, boxing can be explained as fist fighting as a sport.

words.example: Boxing is one of the world's best-known combat sports.
words.exampleZh: 拳擊是全球最著名的格鬥運動之一。

exercises.original: Boxing is a fighting sport in which competitors strike mainly with their fists.
exercises.zh: 拳擊是一項主要以拳頭擊打的格鬥運動。
exercises.upgrade: Boxing is a combat sport in which competitors strike mainly with their fists.

exercises.original: The programme introduces students to boxing and other fighting sports.
exercises.zh: 課程向學生介紹拳擊及其他格鬥運動。
exercises.upgrade: The programme introduces students to boxing and other combat sports.

options.explanation: boxing 是 combat sports 的一種。

exercises.original: Boxing belongs to the same broad sports category as wrestling and judo.
exercises.zh: 拳擊與摔跤和柔道同屬一個廣泛運動類別。
exercises.upgrade: Boxing belongs to the category of combat sports.

words.note: 和 combat sport 接近，可在一般文字中概括 boxing。
words.example: Boxing is a fighting sport that requires speed, discipline, and technique.
words.exampleZh: 拳擊是一項需要速度、自律和技巧的搏擊運動。

exercises.original: Boxing is a sport based on controlled fighting under rules.
exercises.zh: 拳擊是一項在規則下進行受控搏擊的運動。
exercises.upgrade: Boxing is a fighting sport based on controlled competition.

options.explanation: 一般語言中可自然概括 boxing。

exercises.original: The school offers boxing as one of several fighting sports.
exercises.zh: 學校把拳擊列為多種搏擊運動之一。
exercises.upgrade: The school offers boxing as one of several fighting sports.

exercises.original: Boxing is a fighting sport, but it is not the same as kickboxing.
exercises.zh: 拳擊是一項搏擊運動，但和踢拳並不相同。
exercises.upgrade: Boxing is a fighting sport, but it is not the same as kickboxing.

words.note: boxing 的一個特定變體，指不戴傳統拳擊手套進行的拳賽。
words.example: Bare-knuckle boxing follows different rules from modern gloved boxing.
words.exampleZh: 裸拳拳擊的規則與現代戴手套拳擊不同。

exercises.original: This form of boxing is fought without traditional boxing gloves.
exercises.zh: 這種拳擊形式不使用傳統拳擊手套。
exercises.upgrade: This form of boxing is bare-knuckle boxing.

options.explanation: without traditional boxing gloves 是直接線索。
規則允許踢擊，重點不同。
是獨自練習，不是正式比賽。

exercises.original: The documentary compares modern gloved boxing with an older form of boxing.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片比較現代戴手套拳擊與較早期的裸拳拳擊。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary compares modern gloved boxing with bare-knuckle boxing.

options.explanation: 和 gloved boxing 形成直接對比。

exercises.original: Bare-knuckle contests are a specific form of boxing rather than a synonym for all boxing.
exercises.zh: 裸拳比賽是拳擊的一種特定形式，而不是所有拳擊的同義名稱。
exercises.upgrade: Bare-knuckle boxing is a specific form of boxing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 打鬥不等於拳擊 fighting 可以是任何形式的打鬥，甚至是沒有規則的衝突。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They were fighting in the street. They were boxing in a regulated match.

falseSynonyms.zh: 拳頭打架不等於拳擊運動 fistfight 通常指非正式、非運動性的打架。
是上位詞，不是完全同義詞 Boxing 是 combat sport 的一種； MMA、wrestling、judo 也屬於 combat sports。
武術不等於拳擊 有些人會把 boxing 廣義歸入 martial arts，但 martial art 的範圍遠大於 boxing。
踢拳不等於拳擊 Kickboxing 允許踢擊；boxing 主要以拳擊技術為核心。
綜合格鬥不等於拳擊 MMA 結合拳擊、踢擊、摔跤、地面技等多種技術。
摔跤不等於拳擊 Wrestling 以摔、控制和壓制為主，而非拳擊。
詞義與詞性不同 - boxer = 拳擊手 - boxing = 拳擊運動 - box = 動詞「打拳擊」
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is a boxer. She trains in boxing. She boxes professionally.
